coordinates.rig: Top-left source coordinates stored as 627 units per square, at pixel centres. Convert to 512 or 1254 raster pixels by multiplying by width/627.
coordinates.reflection: One horizontal runtime reflection. Normalized prepared X = 1 - source X/627. Pixel index x maps to width - 1 - x.
coordinates.display: Multiply normalized coordinates by the SwiftUI sprite side in points. Multiply points by displayScale for physical pixels.
coordinates.dials: Each [x,y,xRadius,yRadius] describes the inner dial, excluded from all material channels. In visible dials, two painted hands read 10:10 and 03:00 in the prepared orientation. Partial mounts are metal.
coordinates.registration: [uniformScale,tx,ty,groundCorrection,bodyBlendStart,rawSole]; the ground correction is interpolated below the jaw only. The opening and standing image share the same framing.
